full_text: COMPLAINT OR BENEFIT CLAIM/REQUEST FORM — Non-Medicare California. Kaiser Permanente. Form includes fields for Member/Patient Name, Medical Record Number, Address, Birth Date, and Representative Details. Requests description of the nature of the issue, how resolution was attempted, and proposed solution. Stamped with 'DO NOT FILE IN PATIENT CHART' at the bottom.
